documentTitle: Air Intelligence Information Report — Unidentified Flying Object
originator: Major Paul W. Henderson, 100th Bomb Wing (M), SAC, DCOI, Pease AFB, New Hampshire
archiveCustody: Betty and Barney Hill Papers, 1961-2006, MC 197, Box 5, Folder 1, Milne Special Collections and Archives, University of New Hampshire
extraction: Embedded JPEG extracted from the university-hosted DOCX and rotated 90 degrees for upright display; document content otherwise unchanged.
copyrightStatus: Underlying U.S. Air Force record is a U.S. federal government work; reuse status of the UNH-hosted collection photograph was not independently adjudicated.
supports: The Hills reported a strange object observed through their windshield while traveling south on Route 3 near Lincoln, New Hampshire, during the night of September 19-20, 1961.
Pease AFB intelligence created a signed Air Intelligence Information Report on September 21, 1961.
The report records a separate radar incident and says time and distance could hint at a possible relationship while explicitly declining to determine one.
limitations: The report documents the initial aerial-object account, not a kidnapping or abduction.
It states that the radar observation provided no description and does not establish a relationship between the observations.
The referenced Daily Report of Controller attachment is not included in the recovered public page.
